name: Gods Purpose
overview: Scripture reveals that God's purpose is sovereign and unchanging, as He declares the end from the beginning and accomplishes all His pleasure (Isaiah 46:10). Though human plans may abound, it is the counsel of the LORD that ultimately stands firm (Proverbs 19:21). Believers can trust that God works all things together for good according to His purpose for those who love Him and are called by Him (Romans 8:28). This divine purpose includes a personal dimension, promising peace and a hopeful future to His people (Jeremiah 29:11), and assures that He will perfect what concerns each individual, never forsaking the works of His hands (Psalms 138:8).
